{{Quote|My medal. The one I got for the battle of the Death Star. It's the highest honor the Alliance gives. Maybe I should have taken better care of the thing. It's starting to look a little tarnished...|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SW62">[[Star Wars (1977) 62|''Star Wars'' (1977) 62]]</ref>}}
The '''Medal of Bravery''' was a [[Gold/Legends|golden]] military decoration awarded by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were amongst the Alliance recipients of the medal, during the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]] that followed the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. That ceremony was held in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]], an ancient structure located on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]], with hundreds of Alliance personnel attending the event.

==Description==
The Medal of Bravery shared the same design as the [[Medal of Alderaan]], another award given out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|300|Medal of Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|300|Medal of Bravery}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|No big deal? I felt my temper rise. I pointed out acidly that he could always pawn the medal for cash.|Leia Organa, upon Han Solo's initial refusal of the award|<ref name="CTE">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref>}}
[[File:CWA-golden_medals.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Two Clone Wars&ndash;era Medals of Bravery on display]]
The Medal of Bravery existed as far back as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Confederacy]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. At least four copies of it were exposed in the [[Officers' Club]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="CWA" />

More than twenty years later, the Medal of Bravery had become the highest military decoration awarded by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="SW62" /> It was made of [[Gold/Legends|gold]]<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> and attached to a [[Color/Legends|brown]] ribbon, as it was designed to be draped over the head and worn around the neck.<ref name="ANH" /> It was presented to members of the Alliance who had displayed a great feat of bravery in battle.

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], for their efforts in destroying the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were awarded this honorable medal during the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]].<ref name="ANH" /> At first, Solo was reluctant to accept the award, arguing that the ones who deserved medals were the ones who didn't make it back. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who was asked to preside over the ceremony, was very moved by the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] words, and she spoke to him as a comrade, prompting Solo to accept the award.<ref name="CTE" />

[[File:Medals.png|thumb|250px|Han Solo and Luke Skywalker after receiving the Medal following the destruction of the Death Star]]
The medal presentation ceremony was held in the [[Grand Audience Chamber]], the topmost room of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], a huge ziggurat that hosted the Rebellion's primary base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" /> [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who was Solo's best friend and copilot, did not receive a medal during the official ceremony, as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] do not place any meaning in such tangible awards.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> However, at the request of Solo, Chewbacca was presented with his own medal in private, during the feast that followed the ceremony. Princess Leia, who was too short to put it over the Wookiee's neck, stood on a table to award this final medal.<ref name="TDADS" />

Some time after [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd's]] death in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], which led to the destruction of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], he was posthumously awarded the Medal of Bravery.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Leia is dressed in a long white dress and is staggeringly beautiful. She places a gold medallion around Han's neck. He winks at her. To one side, a pristine Threepio stands, awestruck by the whole event.|Extract from the final script of ''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope''|<ref name="BTM" />}}
The Medal of Bravery first appeared during the triumphal end sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> The ceremony scene emulates a similar segment in [[Wikipedia:Triumph of the Will|''Triumph of the Will'']], a [[Wikipedia:Nazi|Nazi]] propaganda film made by [[Wikipedia:Leni Riefenstahl|Leni Riefenstahl]] in 1934.<ref name="BTM" />

Many fans expressed their unhappiness over the fact that Chewbacca was not awarded a medal at the end of the movie,<ref name="BTM" /> although he was in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]].<ref name="ANHN" /> In an interview recorded shortly after the release of ''A New Hope'', [[George Lucas]] explained that Wookiees do not care for medals. However, a large contingent of Alliance officers were sent to the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for a memorable celebration.<ref name="BTM" /><ref name="Official Star Wars Fan Club 2">"Q & A," [[Official Star Wars Fan Club 2|''Bantha Tracks #2'']]</ref> Despite this, however, he later claimed in an interview with the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Official Star Wars Fan Club]] that Chewbacca ''did'' claim a medal, but not during the formal ceremony because Leia was too short.

[[File:Chewie_medal.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Chewbacca receiving his medal from Princess Leia]]
In the early comic book ''[[The Day after the Death Star!]]'', Chewbacca did receive a medal, but not at the same time as Solo and Skywalker. A panel shows Princess Leia standing on a table to award Chewbacca his medal at a party after the formal ceremony.<ref name="TDADS" /> Additionally, the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Tag & Bink Are Dead 2|''Tag & Bink Are Dead'' 2]] depicts [[Tag Greenly|Tag Greenley]] and [[Bink Otauna/Legends|Bink Otauna]] finding a Medal of Bravery engraved with "Chewie" that was left behind in the Great Temple.<ref name="TBAD">[[Tag & Bink Are Dead 2|''Tag & Bink Are Dead'' 2]]</ref>

At the [[1997]] [[Wikipedia:MTV Movie Awards|MTV Movie Awards]], Chewbacca was given a Medal of Bravery by [[Carrie Fisher]], who played [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] throughout the [[original trilogy]].

A lanyard acting as a replica of the Medal of Bravery was issued to visitors of [[Star Wars Weekends|''Star Wars'' Weekends]] [[2014]].<ref name="Star Wars Weekends 2014 Gets New Merchandise and Rebel Rendezvous">{{SW|url=news/new-merchandise-and-rebel-rendezvous-event-coming-to-star-wars-weekends-2014-at-disneys-hollywood-studios|text=''Star Wars'' Weekends 2014 Gets New Merchandise and "Rebel Rendezvous"|nolive=1}}</ref>
